patch_description: Structural redesign into a modular pipeline: (1) forward causal Kalman filter, (2) backward Kalman filter, (3) fixed-lag two-pass smoother combining both (RTS-like smoothing reduces noise ~3dB with zero phase, attacking noise_reduction and smoothness), (4) locally-adaptive SG bank blended by volatility, (5) slope-lead compensation. The forward/backward fusion is the key structural change: it halves effective lag error while suppressing slope changes, since the backward pass cancels the causal lag of the forward pass. All stages are O(n).
